ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- attributes.queryParams.matterId default payload.matterId default payload.matter_id
%dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = payload.extractedDataJson default payload.extracted_data_json default payload --- if (raw is String) read(raw, "application/json") else raw

choice.doc:name: Choice Fetch File If ContentVersion Given

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query file metadata
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Title, FileExtension, PathOnClient, FileType, ContentDocumentId FROM ContentVersion WHERE Id = ':contentVersionId'

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import withMaxSize from dw::core::Strings var rawName = (payload.Title[0] default "Bill") ++ ("." ) ++ (payload.FileExtension[0] default "pdf") --- withMaxSize((rawName replace /[^a-zA-Z0-9.]/ with "_"), 80)

http:request.doc:name: Login Salesforce REST
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { grant_type: "client_credentials", client_id: p("salesforce.clientId"), client_secret: p("salesforce.clientSecret") }]

logger.doc:name: Log No ContentVersion Id
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "SKIP_SOURCE_FILE_FETCH", "reason": "No contentVersionId in the request, so there is nothing to upload to SharePoint." }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: if (vars.matterDocumentId != null) "Success" else "Error", message: if (vars.matterDocumentId != null) "Matter Document created successfully in Salesforce" else "Matter Document creation failed; see the Mule log for the Salesforce error", documentTypeCode: vars.documentTypeCode default p('idp.documentTypeCode'), matterId: vars.matterId, idpDocumentTypeId: vars.idpDocumentTypeId, matterDocumentId: vars.matterDocumentId default null, fileLink: vars.fileLink default null }

logger.doc:name: Log Matter Doc Error
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "MATTER_DOC_REQUEST_ERROR", "errorType": error.errorType.identifier, "description": error.description, "matterId": vars.matterId, "idpDocumentTypeId": vars.idpDocumentTypeId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "Error", message: error.description default "Matter Document creation failed", errorType: error.errorType.identifier default null, idpDocumentTypeId: vars.idpDocumentTypeId }

salesforce:query.doc:name: RecordTypeId Query
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id FROM RecordType WHERE SobjectType = 'Matter_Document__c' AND (Name = 'Bill' OR DeveloperName = 'Bill') LIMIT 1

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var tables = vars.data.tables default {} --- tables.Inline default ((tables pluck ((tbl, key) -> tbl)) filter ($ is Array))[0] default []]
set-variable.doc:name: lineItems Set Variable

choice.doc:name: Choice Create Line Items If Any

logger.doc:name: Log No Line Items
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "SKIP_LINE_ITEM_CREATE", "reason": "The extraction returned no table rows for this bill.", "matterDocumentId": vars.matterDocumentId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "Success", message: "Matter Document created successfully in Salesforce", salesforceId: vars.matterDocumentId default null }

choice.doc:name: Choice Upload Only If File Present

logger.doc:name: Log Skip Upload No File
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "SKIP_MSGRAPH_UPLOAD_NO_FILE", "reason": "No source file binary or no Matter_Document__c was created, so there is nothing to upload or link.", "matterDocumentId": vars.matterDocumentId default null }]

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Case_Number_Formula__c
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Case_Number_Formula__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = ':matterId'

http:request.doc:name: Login MSGraph
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { grant_type: "client_credentials", client_id: p("microsoft.graph.clientId"), client_secret: p("microsoft.graph.clientSecret"), scope: p("microsoft.graph.scope") }]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.relativePath as String splitBy "/") map ((seg) -> dw::core::URL::encodeURIComponent(seg)) joinBy "/"]
set-variable.doc:name: Set encodedRelativePath

choice.doc:name: Choice Upload If Case Folder Matched
Choice Link Update If Matter Doc Created

when.expression: #[vars.matterDocumentId != null and trim(vars.matterDocumentId as String) != '' and vars.fileLink != null]

logger.message: 'Skipping Link__c update: either no Matter_Document__c record was created, or no fileLink was returned by MSGraph.'
